title: 第5章 青龙邀月前往矿山第6章 矿山情况连环毒计
slug: 朝廷鹰犬没挨过六扇门的刀
content_zh:
青龙邀月，前往矿山。
“你要去哪！”躲在角落偷听的李君意看着直愣愣走出议事厅大门的李君肃，拉了拉他的袖子。
“啊，意姐，我要去书阁。”李君肃回过神，看着李君意，笑了笑。
“这样，你去吧，等你回来。”李君意朝李君肃眨了眨眼。
“知道了意姐，中午见。”李君肃点了点头应下。
书阁，只能自己前往。
不管是口谕还是手谕，只有自己能前往。
一次一人。
书阁。
“武伯，家主跟长老让我去顶楼。”李君肃一拱手，缓缓开口。
“二少爷？上去吧。”李武在书桌後面睁开眼，眼里闪过一丝精芒，而後点了点头。
李君肃闻言直接走上顶楼。
“就是这本了吧？”李君肃看着青色封面，金色字体的古书，有些期待。
【青龙邀月，快刀出海，杀人不沾血，抹喉不见红，便为入门。】
【天赐良缘，得龙气一丝，可见真意，入地级。】
“快刀”李君肃眼中闪过一丝惊艳，喃喃开口。
这功法，特化杀人技。
“武伯，我回去了。”李君肃把功法放在桌面上，看着李武。
“嗯，自己摘抄，一月後还回来。”李武点了点头。
“好的武伯。”李君肃点头后离开。

“青龙邀月家主为了你，也是费了不少心思啊。”李武喃喃道，缓缓闭上眼。
君子院。
“你回来了。”坐在石桌旁的李君意，看着君肃笑了。
“嗯，意姐，这本功法到时候给你摘抄一份。”李君肃挥了挥手里的功法。
“不要。”李君意说道。
“这个被发现，你会被罚的，你给我，我就不理你了。”李君意坚决的拒绝道。
“好吧意姐。”李君肃看着坚决的李君意，只得无奈的轻笑了一下。
“好了，你这武痴又要练武了吧，去吧去吧。”李君意挥了挥手，而後趴在石桌上。
李君肃又不陪她。
李君肃看着把这里当成自己家的李君意，只能无奈的摇了摇头。
一月後，议事厅。
“你，这麽快就小成了？”李毅年看着李君肃眼神闪过的锐利，不可思议的问道。
content_en:
Qinglong invites Yue to go to the mine.
"Where are you going!" Li Junyi, who was hiding in the corner and eavesdropping, looked at Li Junsu who walked out of the chamber door blankly, and pulled his sleeve.
"Ah, Sister Yi, I want to go to the bookstore." Li Junsu came back to his senses, looked at Li Junyi, and smiled.
"In this case, you go ahead and wait until you come back." Li Junyi winked at Li Junsu.
"I know, sister Yi, see you at noon." Li Junsu nodded in agreement.
You can only go to the Book Pavilion by yourself.
Whether it is an oral or handwritten message, only you can go there.
One person at a time.
Bookstore.
"Uncle Wu, the head of the family and the elders asked me to go to the top floor." Li Junsu cupped his hands and spoke slowly.
"Second Young Master? Go up." Li Wu opened his eyes behind the desk, a glimmer of light flashed in his eyes, and then he nodded.
After hearing this, Li Junsu went directly to the top floor.
"Is this the one?" Li Junsu looked at the ancient book with a cyan cover and gold fonts, looking forward to it.
[The blue dragon invites the moon, the sharp sword goes to the sea, the killing is not stained with blood, and the throat is not stained with blood, it is the beginning. 】
[God-given marriage, a trace of dragon energy, and the true meaning can be seen, reaching the earth level. 】
"Quick Knife" Li Junsu murmured with a hint of surprise in his eyes.
This skill is a special killing technique.
"Uncle Wu, I'm going back." Li Junsu put the technique on the table and looked at Li Wu.
"Well, copy it yourself and come back in one month." Li Wu nodded.
"Okay Uncle Wu." Li Junsu nodded and left.
"Master Qinglong Yueyue has put a lot of thought into doing it for you." Li Wu murmured and slowly closed his eyes.
Gentleman's Courtyard.
"You're back." Li Junyi, who was sitting at the stone table, looked at Jun Su and smiled.
"Well, Sister Yi, I will give you an excerpt from this exercise book when the time comes." Li Junsu waved the exercise in his hand.
"No." Li Junyi said.
"If this is discovered, you will be punished. If you give it to me, I will ignore you." Li Junyi firmly refused.
"Okay, sister Yi." Li Junsu looked at the determined Li Junyi and had no choice but to chuckle helplessly.
"Okay, you martial arts idiot is going to practice martial arts again, go ahead." Li Junyi waved his hand and then lay down on the stone table.
Li Junsu didn't accompany her.
Li Junsu looked at Li Junyi who regarded this place as his home, and could only shake his head helplessly.
One month later, the Chamber.
"You, have you become successful so quickly?" Li Yinian asked in disbelief, seeing the sharp look in Li Junsu's eyes.
